spatialModel.summary: 進門與離門之間是一段獨立空間；所有實驗遺留、玻璃瓶、黃金都發生在這段空間內，穿越發生在離門之後。

eventOrder.rule: 先發生廢墟內所有探索與發現，穿越發生在後面。
phaseA_taiwan2026_ruin_events: enter ruin and atmospheric wrong details
open-room dead with time and cause evidence
grey glass bottles with WWII-soaked corpses
continue deeper while still in Taiwan 2026
phaseB_crossing_later: only after Phase A is complete
no return to ruin or remaining gold
eventOrder.hardBoundary: Bottles, gold, and experiment horror are fully experienced in Taiwan before any crossing. Do not mix fantasy world cues into bottle or gold scenes.

placement.rule: Discoveries unfold while 陸塵行 and 愛醬 continue deeper together. All ruin horror and gold events finish before displacement begins.

explorationPacing.principle: 鉅細靡遺，但分段呈現；不是一間房間讲完所有恐怖。
layers: deeper sealed zone toward 逆行門 residual structure
explorationPacing.aijiangRole: 愛醬 stops at doorways, hacks low, refuses bottles, stays pressed to 陸塵行 when metal smell and dead air increase.

visibleEvidence: rusted gurneys bolted to sloped floors
ceramic sinks with old blood tide lines above normal drain height
wall-mounted measurement scales in both metric and wartime Japanese units
broken glass chart tubes and cracked recording dials frozen at unreadable numbers
leather restraint straps cut away in haste, some still buckled empty
chalk tally marks grouped in fives on concrete pillars
Chinese characters scratched low on walls, not official signage
experimentalRemnants.functionalMeaning: These are not random war damage. They are calibration, restraint, measurement, and disposal traces of 逆行門計畫 human experiments.

theDead.authorRule: Death presentation must follow time, cause, and location logic. No anonymous horror wallpaper.

timeLayers.state: dessicated remains in side rooms where sealing failed or bodies were left for baseline comparison
timeLayers.deathWindow: months to weeks before final activation

timeLayers.state: freshest pre-seal casualties and rushed disposal piles
timeLayers.deathWindow: days to hours before facility abandonment

timeLayers.state: no intact bodies near the gate room; only drag marks and missing personnel records
timeLayers.deathWindow: same night Japanese advance team entered and never returned

causeCategories.description: Repeated biological measurement under cold, dehydration, and stimulant injection until heart failure.
causeCategories.bodySigns: needle kerf clusters on inner arms, cracked lips, rib-visible collapse, often labeled with numbers not names.

causeCategories.description: Sealed chamber tests for atmospheric response; victims died from oxygen deprivation or chemical lung burn.
causeCategories.bodySigns: darkened lips, broken fingernails from inside-door scratching, nostril bleeding dried to rust color.

causeCategories.description: Used to test whether body response could serve as temporal anchor data.
causeCategories.bodySigns: waxy pale skin, extremity discoloration, cloth stripped to increase measurement accuracy.

causeCategories.description: Subjects who survived long enough to see too much were killed before surrender and disposal.
causeCategories.bodySigns: single precise wounds, hands bound in wire, tags removed to prevent identification.

theDead.ethicsGuard: Write as war crime evidence and architectural horror, not spectacle torture porn. Focus on objects, numbers, room design, and 陸塵行's physical reaction.

greyGlassBottles.description: Large grey-toned glass vessels, bigger than hospital reagent jars, lined on steel racks or sunk into concrete wells.
greyGlassBottles.glass: Thick wartime industrial glass with air bubbles, brown-grey fogging at the shoulders, metal clamp lids corroded shut.
greyGlassBottles.fluid: Originally clear preservation liquid; after eighty years it has turned murky grey-brown with floating particulate.
greyGlassBottles.contents: Whole corpses or major body sections preserved from WWII; not skeletons only.

preservationLogic.whyStillVisible: Facility used a wartime chemical preservation formula meant to keep tissue measurable for years.
preservationLogic.whyGrey: Long degradation of formaldehyde-family solution mixed with mineral sediment from coastal humidity seepage.
preservationLogic.whyIntactEnough: Only sealed bottles survived; unsealed specimens rotted elsewhere.

discoveryBeat.order: after open-room remains, before gold cache
discoveryBeat.action: 陸塵行 approaches one bottle because the shape is wrong for reagent storage and the size is too large.
discoveryBeat.clarityMoment: He moves his light closer and realizes the floating mass is a human body that has been soaking since the war.
discoveryBeat.aijiangReaction: 愛醬 recoils, may vomit dryly, will not approach the rack again.
discoveryBeat.luReaction: Not heroic bravery. Nausea, anger without vocabulary, and the understanding that this place was never merely abandoned.

greyGlassBottles.deathTimeInBottles: Most bottled subjects died between late 1944 and July 1945, then were immersed within hours to days after death.
greyGlassBottles.deathCauseInBottles: Primarily 標定耗竭 and 窒息或廢氣 subjects chosen because their bodies were considered 'complete datasets' worth preserving.

goldDiscovery.publicLegendEcho: 二戰末期传说：日本人走得急，留在台湾的黄金来不及运走。
goldDiscovery.authorTruth: This facility held a separate operational gold cache for 逆行門計畫, not all of Taiwan's rumored buried gold.
goldDiscovery.location: Command office or vault niche behind a false wall near records destruction point.
form: military wooden crates with imperial-era shipping marks
some coins and uncut bar stock for local emergency payment
goldDiscovery.whyStillHere: Final personnel prioritized sealing the gate and destroying records over moving weight they believed would be captured anyway.

luChenxingAction.behavior: He understands weight immediately because he has real hands-on life experience.
luChenxingAction.takes: Only what he can carry while still moving, protecting 愛醬, and keeping one hand free for light or balance.
luChenxingAction.doesNotTake: Most of the cache remains because gold is too heavy and escape still matters.
luChenxingAction.emotion: Not greed first. Practical shock: this much gold exists in a place history forgot.

crossingAndNoReturn.timing: 穿越 strictly happens after bottles, gold, and continued exploration. Not during them.
sequence: Phase A complete: he has seen bottles, taken some gold, and kept exploring in the Taiwan ruin.
He may still think he can return for more gold later.
Only then, in a later segment, displacement begins in the liminal zone without a clean timestamp.
After displacement, returning to the Taiwan ruin and the remaining gold is impossible.

noReturnLogic.characterKnowledge: 陸塵行 does not know when he crossed.
noReturnLogic.authorTruth: The 2026 coastal node closes after passage; the Taiwan ruin remains on the other side of a fracture he cannot re-find.
noReturnLogic.goldConsequence: The gold he left behind is lost with the unreachable ruin.

mustDetail: what the flashlight catches first vs second
smell progression: rust -> old chemical -> sweet-decay -> preserved fluid
how 愛醬's leash-free distance changes
how 陸塵行 counts exits and keeps bearings
weight of gold in hands, pockets, belt wrap, or improvised cloth

Let 陸塵行 instantly understand 逆行門計畫.
Let him return later to the same ruin after crossing.
